method.kind: Public primary project README, license, source pages, current local source and existing plan review
method.evidenceBoundary: Selected mutable InventorLoader source paths document an ezdxf-to-AcisReader DXF route and FreeCAD Part shape construction; the full parser was not audited. No immutable source/runtime, input artifact, native result, complete ACIS profile, DWG/AcDs ingestion, or independent kernel result was established. The repository license text and prior add-on metadata conflict remains unresolved.

findings.topic: Existing InventorLoader candidate receives a narrower DXF handoff and safety qualification
observed: The README describes SAT/SAB import into FreeCAD, DXF 3D-solid import, release status 1.5, and no export support.
importerDXF.py uses ezdxf to read DXF and extracts either an entity sab or sat payload before calling the add-on's AcisReader.
Acis.py contains dedicated text and binary parsing code; importerSAT.py maps parsed bodies to FreeCAD Part::Feature shapes.
The add-on documents unsupported blending surfaces, helix surfaces, and some law-defined geometry without spline data; its body resolver stops at ACIS history markers.
The GitHub LICENSE contains GPL-2.0 text, while prior FreeCAD add-on metadata in the plan carried an LGPL label; license provenance is unresolved.
Prior source review identified an unrestricted Python eval path for ACIS law expressions; this follow-up retains the existing safety preflight and does not claim it is fixed.
No code was copied or vendored.
doesNotEstablish: an immutable source revision or current FreeCAD/platform runtime
successful parsing of any particular generated or producer SAT/SAB payload
complete or closed B-rep output, history preservation, or semantics for unsupported ACIS profiles
DWG or DWG AcDs reading, because the inspected path begins from DXF/SAT/SAB
independent kernel evidence, because shape construction uses FreeCAD Part/Open CASCADE lineage
findings.planUse: Retain the already-listed OPTIONAL_CANDIDATE / DXF_ACIS_CONSUMER at the existing composed FreeCAD checkpoint only. Pin the add-on and FreeCAD build, satisfy the previously specified source-safety and resource preflight, record exact converter handoff for any DWG-derived DXF, preserve a source-handle/owner sidecar, compare per-body topology and analytic metrics against a local manifest, and keep the result as parser/consumer evidence rather than a second kernel vote or support promotion.
